// diagnostic

E0373

This loop header uses a semicolon.

What

This loop header uses a semicolon.

Why

Commas separate loop clauses; semicolons separate statements.

Fix

Replace `;` with `,`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0373: tests/ui/loop_header_semicolon_retired.stderr.

Error [E0373]: this loop header uses a semicolon
  --> tests/ui/loop_header_semicolon_retired.jet:2:14
    |
  2 |     loop item; [1, 2, 3] { print(item) }
    |              ^
 Why: commas separate loop clauses; semicolons separate statements
 Fix: replace `;` with `,`; `jet fmt` applies this fix
